decision: Verified public internet, LinkedIn and external-provider evidence about a known connection or its company becomes standard context on the canonical relationship graph and must feed person, company, customer, opportunity and next-best-action intelligence.
prevention_rule: Never leave relevant external evidence as a report-only event. Attach it to the existing relationship graph, preserve source/freshness/confidence, and reuse it through canonical Powerhouse intelligence. LinkedIn activity is a signal, never standalone buying proof.
sources: DataForSEO/Tavily/provider evidence already admitted to runtime
